beats.clause: five AI video tools, five very different promises
beats.stage: Face full-screen in a dark room. Five unlabelled tiles fade up behind the head, staggered, then hold.

beats.clause: I tested all five across the same brief
beats.stage: Room lifts to light on the word tested. The five tiles shrink into a left rail and gain names; the face docks to a panel bottom-right.

carries.as: shrunk into a named left rail

beats.clause: and one of them was not close
beats.stage: Four rail tiles dim to 20%; the fifth scales up centre-frame and holds. Cut to white on the final word.
